sun.java2d.pipe

接口 AATileGenerator


  • public interface AATileGenerator
    The API for an object that generates alpha coverage tiles for a given path. The RenderingEngine will be consulted as a factory to return one of these objects for a given Shape and a given set of rendering attributes. This object will iterate through the bounds of the rendering primitive and return tiles of a constant size as specified by the getTileWidth() and getTileHeight() parameters. The iteration order of the tiles will be as specified by the pseudo-code: 
         int bbox[] = {left, top, right, bottom};
     AATileGenerator aatg = renderengine.getAATileGenerator(..., bbox);
     int tw = aatg.getTileWidth();
     int th = aatg.getTileHeight();
     byte tile[] = new byte[tw * th];
     for (y = top; y < bottom; y += th) {
         for (x = left; x < right; x += tw) {
             int a = aatg.getTypicalAlpha();
             int w = Math.min(tw, right-x);
             int h = Math.min(th, bottom-y);
             if (a == 0x00) {
                 // can skip this tile...
                 aatg.nextTile();
             } else if (a == 0xff) {
                 // can treat this tile like a fillRect
                 aatg.nextTile();
                 doFill(x, y, w, h);
             } else {
                 aatg.getAlpha(tile, 0, tw);
                 handleAlpha(tile, x, y, w, h);
             }
         }
     }
     aatg.dispose();
    The bounding box for the iteration will be returned by the RenderingEngine via an argument to the getAATileGenerator() method.

    • 方法详细资料

      • getTileWidth

        int getTileWidth()
        Gets the width of the tiles that the generator batches output into.
        返回:
        the width of the standard alpha tile

      • getTileHeight

        int getTileHeight()
        Gets the height of the tiles that the generator batches output into.
        返回:
        the height of the standard alpha tile

      • getTypicalAlpha

        int getTypicalAlpha()
        Gets the typical alpha value that will characterize the current tile. The answer may be 0x00 to indicate that the current tile has no coverage in any of its pixels, or it may be 0xff to indicate that the current tile is completely covered by the path, or any other value to indicate non-trivial coverage cases.
        返回:
        0x00 for no coverage, 0xff for total coverage, or any other value for partial coverage of the tile

      • nextTile

        void nextTile()
        Skips the current tile and moves on to the next tile. Either this method, or the getAlpha() method should be called once per tile, but not both.

      • getAlpha

        void getAlpha(byte[] tile,
              int offset,
              int rowstride)
        Gets the alpha coverage values for the current tile. Either this method, or the nextTile() method should be called once per tile, but not both.

      • dispose

        void dispose()
        Disposes this tile generator. No further calls will be made on this instance.
